titulo: I Gave an Old Lady a Ride. Then I Saw Her Arms | Urban Legend #Shorts
titulo_pt: Dei carona pra uma velhinha. Aí vi os braços dela | Lenda urbana
resumo_pt: Lenda urbana do carona de braços peludos. A narradora encontra uma senhora pedindo carona na saída do shopping e deixa ela entrar. No sinal, percebe que a senhora tem braços grossos e peludos de homem. Ela inventa que o farol queimou e pede pra 'velhinha' sair e conferir, e arranca com o carro. Na bolsa esquecida no banco havia um machado.
descricao:
She looked like someone's grandma.

Would you have noticed?

Follow @VeilFrequency for a new horror story every day. Based on a classic American urban legend. Images are AI-generated.

scenes.text: It was raining when I left the mall. Almost closing time. The parking lot was nearly empty.
scenes.pt: Estava chovendo quando saí do shopping. Quase na hora de fechar. O estacionamento estava quase vazio.
scenes.visual: nearly empty mall parking lot at night in the rain, one car under a lamp

scenes.text: An old lady was standing next to my car. Gray hair, long coat, a big leather handbag.
scenes.pt: Uma senhora estava parada do lado do meu carro. Cabelo grisalho, casaco comprido, uma bolsa grande de couro.
scenes.visual: elderly woman in a long coat with a large handbag standing by a car in the rain at night

scenes.text: Sweetie, my son forgot to pick me up. Could you drive me home?
scenes.pt: Querida, meu filho esqueceu de me buscar. Você me leva pra casa?

scenes.text: She looked tired and soaked. So I said yes.
scenes.pt: Ela parecia cansada e encharcada. Então eu disse que sim.
scenes.visual: woman opening the passenger door of her car for an old lady in the rain

scenes.text: She sat down, put the bag on her lap, and didn't say another word.
scenes.pt: Ela sentou, pôs a bolsa no colo e não falou mais nada.
scenes.visual: old lady sitting in a car passenger seat holding a big handbag, face in shadow

scenes.text: At the first red light, she reached up to fix her hood.
scenes.pt: No primeiro sinal vermelho, ela levantou a mão pra arrumar o capuz.
scenes.visual: red traffic light reflected on a wet windshield at night

scenes.text: Her arm was thick. Covered in dark hair. A man's arm.
scenes.pt: O braço era grosso. Coberto de pelo escuro. Um braço de homem.
scenes.visual: close up of a thick hairy arm under the sleeve of a woman's coat in a dark car

scenes.text: I kept my eyes on the road. My hands were shaking on the wheel.
scenes.pt: Mantive os olhos na estrada. Minhas mãos tremiam no volante.
scenes.visual: woman's hands gripping a steering wheel at night, rain on the windshield

scenes.text: I said, I think my headlight is out. Could you check it for me, ma'am?
scenes.pt: Eu disse: acho que meu farol queimou. A senhora pode dar uma olhada pra mim?
scenes.visual: car stopped on the side of a dark rainy road, headlights on

scenes.text: She opened the door and stepped out into the rain.
scenes.pt: Ela abriu a porta e saiu na chuva.
scenes.visual: figure in a long coat walking toward the front of a car in the rain

scenes.text: I hit the gas and didn't stop until I reached the police station.
scenes.pt: Pisei no acelerador e só parei na delegacia.
scenes.visual: car speeding away on a wet road at night, red taillights

scenes.text: She had left her handbag on the seat.
scenes.pt: Ela tinha deixado a bolsa no banco.
scenes.visual: leather handbag left on an empty car passenger seat
police officer's hands opening a leather handbag under a desk lamp

scenes.text: Inside was a wig. A pair of gloves. And an axe.
scenes.pt: Dentro tinha uma peruca. Um par de luvas. E um machado.
scenes.visual: a gray wig, gloves and a small axe inside an open handbag on a desk

scenes.text: He wasn't waiting for his son. He was waiting for the last car in the lot.
scenes.pt: Ele não estava esperando o filho. Estava esperando o último carro do estacionamento.
scenes.visual: empty mall parking lot at night in the rain
